svg.text: Complete certificates: exact upper-endpoint pass counts
28 fixed directions per curve; within-bank joint and marginal methods use identical radii
Solid: joint. Dashed: signed marginal. H0: old uniform; H1: finite horizon; N1/N2: global; N2L: 128 bins.
Shown range: 0-2 points. All exact thresholds are retained in CSV/JSON. Across-bank changes are descriptive.
